name: variant-design
description: Explore three deliberate interface directions in your code project, compare tradeoffs, refine a scoped region with snapshots, and integrate the chosen output. Uses your existing Codex tools and project stack.

interface.longDescription: Turn a product brief into three runnable interface directions with explicit benefits and tradeoffs. Preserve an existing design system, compare previews, edit one region, undo recorded changes and integrate a named direction into your project. Requires a local code workspace and Node.js 22 or later for bundled helpers. Preview and verification use the project's tooling; browser checks require available browser tools.
defaultPrompt: Create three design directions for this project while preserving its brand.
Compare A, B and C and explain which fits my product task.
Change only B's hero, save a snapshot and show the result.
